critic.fix_suggestion: Apply a multi-part livery to the fuselage and tail primitives: set the upper 60% of the main body cylinder/box primitive to White, the lower 40% to a Solid Gray, and create a separate tail fin geometry with a 50/50 split of Purple and Blue. For the wingtips, replace the single dark primitive with two thin, overlapping rectangular planes colored Purple and Blue respectively to simulate the reference accents.
